name: auryn-cpp
summary: C++ language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cpp engine extracting namespaces/classes/structs/unions/enums (incl. `enum class`)/methods/fields/params/free functions, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS, multiple inheritance), templates, #includes/macros, and calls -- including out-of-line `Class::method` definitions resolved back to their class. A deep libclang engine (template instantiation, overload resolution, ADL, precise header linking) is the planned second phase.
